INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SHIKIKAN_NUIGURUMI.fla: As long as I hug it, even the most troublesome sortie missions can be completely forgotten in my dreams... Zzz...
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SHIKIKAN_NUIGURUMI.des: At the end of your turn, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP, gain [blue]{MotivationGain}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SHIKIKAN_DAKIMAKURA.fl: Upgraded comfort! Now I really don't want to get out of bed...
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-SHIKIKAN_DAKIMAKURA.de:
At the start and end of your turn, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP, gain [blue]{MotivationGain}[/blue] [gold]Motivation[/gold].
Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], triggers an additional time on the first turn of the next combat.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_VIOLIN.title: Royal Violin
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_VIOLIN.flavor: "Commander, just one more piece... Nothing helps me unwind quite like the violin. We can discuss the sortie once the music ends... Zzz..."
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_VIOLIN.descripti: After you [gold]Rest[/gold] at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of each turn in every combat until you enter the next [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_VIOLIN.additiona: Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of each turn in every combat until you enter the next [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEND_LEASE_ACT.title: Lend-Lease Act
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEND_LEASE_ACT.selecti: Choose a Eagle Union {aircraftPrefix:carrierAircraftIcons()} card to add to your Draw Pile.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEND_LEASE_ACT.flavor: Eagle Union support has reached the flight deck.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEND_LEASE_ACT.descrip: At the start of each combat, choose 1 of 3 Eagle Union {aircraftPrefix:carrierAircraftIcons()} cards to add to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. The first time you draw that card, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-IMPLACABLE_HORN.title: Implacable Horn
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-IMPLACABLE_HORN.flavor: One of Miss Implacable's hair ornaments. Hmm... nuns don't usually wear these, do they? Still, she never seems to tire of wearing it while hearing the Commander's confessions...
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-IMPLACABLE_HORN.descri: Whenever your Attacks deal damage, also convert that much of the enemy's HP into its own [gold]Block[/gold]. This conversion cannot reduce its HP below [blue]1[/blue].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_BOUNTY.title: Royal Bounty
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ROYAL_BOUNTY.descripti: At the end of combat, randomly distribute [gold]Gold[/gold] to ALL players equal to [blue]{BountyRate}%[/blue] of the total Max HP of all killed enemies.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LUCKY_BAG.title: Lucky Bag
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LUCKY_BAG.flavor: "Illustrious, we've said our prayers and bought our lucky bags... Shall we find somewhere warm to rest? This little fellow can do the hard work of bringing us good luck this year."
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LUCKY_BAG.description: After spending more than [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] in a single [gold]Shop[/gold], obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold]. Once per shop.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DELIVERY_MANJUU.title: Delivery Manjuu
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DELIVERY_MANJUU.flavor: "Commander, since I'm trying my hand at being a maid, do leave the dessert tasting to me. Just set the plates beside the sofa—that way, I can take my time with each one."
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DELIVERY_MANJUU.descri:
At the end of each combat, receive an additional card reward containing a [gold]Dessert[/gold] enchanted with [gold]Sample[/gold].
Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], remove all [gold]Desserts[/gold] enchanted with [gold]Sample[/gold] from your deck. Gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP for each one removed.
